items.name: Manchester Cubing League - Second 2026
items.information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** Welcome to the first ever cubing league in Manchester! Top 16 finishers from each finals will be awarded points. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManchesterCLSecond2026#67476-manchester-cubing-league). **Please note this competition takes place on a Bank Holiday Monday.** **Only first 16 registered for 4BLD/5BLD can compete in 4BLD/5BLD.** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Kewbz.global](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYxOTcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6829e6558c1a5ecf99757e5e61782b466ebc9d7c/kewbzglobal.png)](https://kewbz.global)

items.name: Uppsalaligan 5: Pouch - 2026

venue.name: [Österledskyrkan](https://osterledskyrkan.se/valkommen-till-forsamlingen/hyr-vara-lokaler/)
venue.details: Enter using the staircase at the building's southern corner.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den femte deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the fifth competition in the spring season of Uppsalaligan 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
